looks.name: Warm Italian
looks.why: Cool grey on top, warm brown below. The herringbone ties both together.

looks.name: Clean Contrast
looks.why: Cream against black reads sharp and calm. Good for a board day.

looks.name: Soft Tailoring
looks.why: The check coat does the talking. A smooth white rib keeps it clean, boots handle wet streets.

looks.name: Minimal & Sharp
looks.why: Near-monochrome with one bright layer at the neck. The sharpest look you own.

looks.name: Relaxed but Deliberate
looks.why: Grey denim and polished loafers lift the zip knit for dinner.

looks.name: Tonal Warm
looks.why: Cream, brown and the oatmeal fleck in the coat. Expensive-looking with no effort.

looks.name: Dark & Refined
looks.why: All dark, three textures. Swap to the white rib if the place is formal.

looks.name: City Weekend
looks.why: Black, denim and white soles. Warm enough for a grey Saturday.

looks.name: Earth Tones
looks.why: Olive, beige and suede sit in the same muted family.

looks.name: Laid-Back Layering
looks.why: The cardigan works as the jacket on mild days. Add a white tee underneath.

looks.name: Travel Day
looks.why: Zip for temperature changes, runners for the airport walk.

looks.name: Navy & Oat
looks.why: A navy knit polo under herringbone, lifted by pale chinos and brown boots.

looks.name: Weekend Zip Polo
looks.why: Navy and mid-blue denim sit in one family; suede sneakers keep it soft.

looks.name: Navy Under Black
looks.why: Navy cable knit, grey trousers, black coat: all cool tones, quiet and sharp.

looks.name: Cable & Check
looks.why: The check coat carries the pattern, the cable knit adds texture underneath.

looks.name: Cream & Check
looks.why: A cream polo brightens the grey check; brown loafers warm the whole look.

looks.name: Pale Blue & Sand
looks.why: Pale blue and sand are an easy pair; the herringbone adds weight for autumn.

looks.name: Black Rib, Grey Tailoring
looks.why: Black on black up top, mid-grey trousers underneath for contrast.

looks.name: Black & Sand
looks.why: A chunky black zip is warm enough alone; beige chinos stop it going severe.

looks.name: Monochrome Office
looks.why: Black cardigan, grey trousers, black loafers: the check coat is the only pattern.

looks.name: Dark Layers
looks.why: Three dark layers in different textures read rich rather than flat.

looks.name: Half-Zip Office
looks.why: Navy and grey are the office default; a ribbed half-zip replaces the blazer.

looks.name: Navy Night
looks.why: Navy between black and charcoal: dark, but not one flat block.

looks.name: Denim & Herringbone
looks.why: A denim shirt under a wool coat, beige chinos to keep it off double denim.

looks.name: Suede & Grey
looks.why: Tan suede, grey knit and brown boots: warm and cool balanced.

looks.name: Suede Weekend
looks.why: Suede and denim are a classic; the charcoal zip keeps the palette calm.

looks.name: Taupe & Brown
looks.why: Taupe sits between the grey check and brown trousers and ties them together.

looks.name: Soft Suede
looks.why: Suede and a fine taupe knit over grey: warm texture, quiet colour.

looks.name: Camel Over Navy
looks.why: Camel over navy is the classic pairing; beige chinos keep it light.

looks.name: Camel & Grey
looks.why: A camel jacket warms a grey-on-grey base; suede sneakers match the jacket.

looks.name: Knit Overshirt Office
looks.why: A knitted overshirt replaces the blazer; taupe and grey stay soft together.

looks.name: Tonal Taupe
looks.why: Camel, taupe and brown in one warm family, with texture doing the work.

looks.name: Chambray & Camel
looks.why: Blue chambray cools down camel and brown; boots keep it evening-ready.

looks.name: Chambray & Herringbone
looks.why: A washed blue shirt under wool herringbone, grey denim to avoid double blue.

looks.name: Navy Knit Shirt Office
looks.why: Navy and grey with brown loafers: the office default made in soft knit.

looks.name: Navy & Brown
looks.why: Navy against brown and camel: rich contrast without any black.

gb.note: Navy gives grey trousers depth. White on grey can look washed out.
All dark reads flat. A light top adds contrast and draws focus to your face.
Olive softens beside blue denim and brown boots. Near-black makes it look drab.
Black fights brown. Grey bridges it and keeps the look warm.
Tonal greys with loafers turn a weekend knit into an evening look.
